notes: Abandoned underground subway station. Reconstruction of the unreleased 2013 UberStrike bluebox (Cmune Dev Game Server, Team Death Match). A long central track trench with a platform each side under an arched-window hall, wrapped by a pillared concourse and a tiled corridor ring, crossed by a catwalk over the tracks. Named after Toronto's real Lower Bay ghost station.
